_readme: Inputs for scripts/garment-photos.mjs. crop is in source-image pixels (left, top, width, height); seed is a point on the garment inside the crop. match sets how close a pixel's hue/saturation/value must be to the garment's colour. bleed (px) pads the garment with its flat colour; changing it moves the garment inside the PNG, so shift the landmarks by the same amount. fade (px) blends the photo into that colour toward its outline. Landmarks in seed.json are in pixels of the cut-out PNG this produces.
